label: Great Compline (Mega Apodeipnon)
description: Great Compline (Mega Apodeipnon) is the solemn Byzantine night office appointed on weekday evenings during Great Lent and on the eves of Nativity and Theophany. It is substantially longer than Small Compline, with two psalm cycles, the Prayer of Manasseh, a variable canon, and an extended closing prayer sequence. CORRECTED 2026-09-26, Horologion audit fix pass, full re-audit (Findings GC1-GC7): originally cited only 'orthodoxprayer.org', a website, not either of this lane's approved governing sources, and had only been spot-checked at the structural level rather than genuinely verified line-by-line. Now fully re-verified word-for-word against UNABHOR1997 (Rassaphor-monk Laurence, The Unabbreviated Horologion or Book of the Hours, Holy Trinity Monastery, 1997), pp.211-237 in full. Corrections: Friday's own weekday-troparia substitution (the Resurrection troparion/kontakion by Octoechos tone, same table as Small Compline's Finding SC4) was missing entirely and is now built (GC2); a fabricated day-dependent closing Theotokion sourced from a different office (Orthros's Exaposteilaria) has been removed (GC7). Still in progress: the entire ten-prayer 'Prayers on Approaching Sleep' block plus the Akathist Kontakion (GC3), correcting the closing dismissal sequence which currently borrows Typika's own forgiveness formula (GC4/GC5). See documentation/HOROLOGION_AUDIT_FINDINGS.md for the full account.
